sources.title: Fijian War Club Inscriptions
sources.author: Fijian warriors
sources.excerpt: I am the club that breaks the waves, the tooth that bites the enemy.
sources.longExcerpt: I am the club that breaks the waves, the tooth that bites the enemy. This historical source from 1800 provides valuable insight into the oceania region during the industrial period. It represents the voices, experiences, and perspectives of people who lived during this transformative time in human history. Such primary sources are essential for understanding not just the major events of history, but the daily lives, beliefs, and struggles of ordinary people across different cultures and time periods.
